name: cloudflare-template-app
description: A full-stack starter running entirely on Cloudflare Workers, with Hono for the API and React for the UI.

scripts.build: wrangler types && pnpm --filter frontend build && vite build
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:list: wrangler d1 migrations list cloudflare-template-app --local --persist-to frontend/.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudflare-template-app --local --persist-to frontend/.wrangler/state
